scope: DEI-T25/26/27/29: authenticated test outcomes before delivery credit and truthful historical failures
review: Community _test binds current scenario identity, status, signed receipt, semantic digest and exact implementation set; client result fields are not trusted.
Admission requires authenticated current facts and eligible Test Card; final rollup separately requires passing and final lifecycle.
Existing signed evidence producer/verifier and real SQL used, not mocked verified flags.
evidence: Passing test admitted with implementation/Test Card in_progress. Completing only implementation does not grant final credit; completing Test Card promotes same record without new input.
Failed signed run is persisted and visible asfailed, never delivery credit. Subsequent success changes currentness without changing the original failure payload; replay preserves original record.
New failed scenario receipt immediately invalidates old passing record before appending a new binding.
Forged signature, mismatched result, unknown implementation and frozen Test Card are refused with no extra record.
Atomic failed-result batch rolls back on an invalid later entry and replays exact receipt after success.

cases: keeps failed outcomes visible alongside the current run without adding delivery credit
test cards record authenticated passed/failed runs during execution, staged=false/true
frontend_review.status: Passing main86 evidence retained; same frontend code, no rerun needed.

limits: Optional narrative progress about an unverified attempt remains the existing progress contract; it is not authenticated test evidence.
Controlled product replay fixture proves cryptographic admission and SQL behavior, not live external harness execution.
No blanket qualification of E1/E2 replacement or multi-Test-Card union from these scenarios.
No product/frontend change; main86 byte proof and eight ZERO closure budgets remain applicable.
No converter, extra ledger, authority relaxation, promotion or real-data operation.
